sentences.text_target: It was a busy Saturday morning in the neighborhood.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪt wɒz ə ˈbɪzi ˈsætədeɪ ˈmɔːnɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈneɪbəhʊd/
sentences.text_native: C'était un samedi matin animé dans le quartier.

sentences.text_target: Mark decided to plan his meals for the entire week.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː plæn hɪz miːlz fɔːr ði ɪnˈtaɪə wiːk/
sentences.text_native: Mark a décidé de planifier ses repas pour toute la semaine.

sentences.text_target: He wanted to cook a special dinner for his friends.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈwɒntɪd tuː kʊk ə ˈspɛʃəl ˈdɪnə fɔːr hɪz frɛndz/
sentences.text_native: Il voulait cuisiner un dîner spécial pour ses amis.

sentences.text_target: He checked his recipe book and wrote down a grocery list.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tʃɛkt hɪz ˈrɛsɪpi bʊk ənd rəʊt daʊn ə ˈɡrəʊsəri lɪst/
sentences.text_native: Il a consulté son livre de recettes et a rédigé une liste de courses.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, he realized he forgot something important.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdnli, hiː ˈrɪəlaɪzd hiː fəˈɡɒt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪmˈpɔːtənt/
sentences.text_native: Soudain, il s'est rendu compte qu'il avait oublié quelque chose d'important.

sentences.text_target: He needed to buy a special sauce instead of the regular one.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈniːdɪd tuː baɪ ə ˈspɛʃəl sɔːs ɪnˈstɛd ɒv ðə ˈrɛɡjʊlə wʌn/
sentences.text_native: Il devait acheter une sauce spéciale au lieu de la classique.

sentences.text_target: Before leaving his apartment, he grabbed his warm jacket.
sentences.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔː ˈliːvɪŋ hɪz əˈpɑːtmənt, hiː ɡræbd hɪz wɔːm ˈdʒækɪt/
sentences.text_native: Avant de quitter son appartement, il a pris sa veste chaude.

sentences.text_target: The weather looked cloudy, so he also took an umbrella.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɛðə lʊkt ˈklaʊdi, səʊ hiː ˈɔːlsəʊ tʊʊk ən ʌmˈbrɛlə/
sentences.text_native: Le temps avait l'air nuageux, alors il a aussi pris un parapluie.

sentences.text_target: He walked down the street towards the local supermarket.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt daʊn ðə striːt təˈwɔːdz ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈsuːpəˌmɑːkɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il a descendu la rue en direction du supermarché local.

sentences.text_target: Soon, he arrived at the automatic sliding doors.
sentences.phonetic: /suːn, hiː əˈraɪvd æt ði ˌɔːtəˈmætɪk ˈslaɪdɪŋ dɔːz/
sentences.text_native: Bientôt, il est arrivé devant les portes automatiques coulissantes.

sentences.text_target: He pushed a metal shopping cart into the busy entrance.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊʃt ə ˈmɛtəl ˈʃɒpɪŋ kɑːt ˈɪntʊ ðə ˈbɪzi ˈɛntrəns/
sentences.text_native: Il a poussé un chariot de courses en métal dans l'entrée animée.

sentences.text_target: First, he walked through the fresh fruit and vegetable department.
sentences.phonetic: /fɜːst, hiː wɔːkt θruː ðə frɛʃ fruːt ənd ˈvɛdʒtəbəl dɪˈpɑːtmənt/
sentences.text_native: D'abord, il a traversé le rayon des fruits et légumes frais.

sentences.text_target: He carefully chose some ripe bananas and juicy tomatoes.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkeəfʊli tʃəʊz sʌm raɪp bəˈnɑːnəz ənd ˈdʒuːsi təˈmɑːtəʊz/
sentences.text_native: Il a choisi avec soin des bananes mûres et des tomates juteuses.

sentences.text_target: Next, he moved towards the dairy section to find fresh milk.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst, hiː muːvd təˈwɔːdz ðə ˈdeəri ˈsɛkʃən tuː faɪnd frɛʃ mɪlk/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il s'est dirigé vers le rayon des produits laitiers pour trouver du lait frais.

sentences.text_target: He compared the prices on the shelf tags before deciding.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː kəmˈpeəd ðə ˈpraɪsɪz ɒn ðə ʃɛlf tæɡz bɪˈfɔːr dɪˈsaɪdɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il a comparé les prix sur les étiquettes des rayonnages avant de se décider.

sentences.text_target: One brand was too expensive, so he picked a cheaper alternative.
sentences.phonetic: /wʌn brænd wɒz tuː ɪkˈspɛnsɪv, səʊ hiː pɪkt ə ˈtʃiːpər ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/
sentences.text_native: Une marque était trop chère, alors il a choisi une alternative moins coûteuse.

sentences.text_target: His shopping cart was getting quite full and heavy.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈʃɒpɪŋ kɑːt wɒz ˈɡɛtɪŋ kwaɪt fʊl ənd ˈhɛvi/
sentences.text_native: Son chariot de courses devenait assez rempli et lourd.

sentences.text_target: He walked down another aisle to look for rice and pasta boxes.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːkt daʊn əˈnʌðə aɪl tuː lʊk fɔː raɪs ənd ˈpæstə ˈbɒksɪz/
sentences.text_native: Il a parcouru une autre allée pour chercher du riz et des boîtes de pâtes.

sentences.text_target: A friendly employee was restocking the shelves nearby.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː wɒz riːˈstɒkɪŋ ðə ʃɛlvz ˈnɪəbaɪ/
sentences.text_native: Un employé sympathique remettait du stock dans les rayons à proximité.

sentences.text_target: Mark smiled and asked him where to find the frozen pizzas.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk smaɪld ənd ɑːskt hɪm wɛə tuː faɪnd ðə ˈfrəʊzən ˈpiːtsəz/
sentences.text_native: Mark a souri et lui a demandé où trouver les pizzas surgelées.

sentences.text_target: After that, he stopped by the local bakery for warm bread.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftə ðæt, hiː stɒpt baɪ ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈbeɪkəri fɔː wɔːm brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Après cela, il est passé par la boulangerie du coin pour acheter du pain chaud.

sentences.text_target: The nice smell of pastry made him even more hungry.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə naɪs smɛl ɒv ˈpeɪstri meɪd hɪm ˈiːvən mɔː ˈhʌŋɡri/
sentences.text_native: La bonne odeur de pâtisserie lui a donné encore plus faim.

sentences.text_target: Finally, he moved towards the checkout area.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli, hiː muːvd təˈwɔːdz ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt ˈeəriə/
sentences.text_native: Finalement, il s'est dirigé vers la zone des caisses.

sentences.text_target: There was a long queue of people waiting patiently.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeə wɒz ə lɒŋ kjuː ɒv ˈpiːpəl ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈpeɪʃəntli/
sentences.text_native: Il y avait une longue file de personnes qui patientaient.

sentences.text_target: The cashier scanned every item quickly on the metal belt.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə kæˈʃɪə skænd ˈɛvri ˈaɪtɪm ˈkwɪkli ɒn ðə ˈmɛtəl bɛlt/
sentences.text_native: La caissière a scanné chaque article rapidement sur le tapis en métal.

sentences.text_target: Mark paid the total amount using his bank card.
sentences.phonetic: /mɑːk peɪd ðə ˈtəʊtəl əˈmaʊnt ˈjuːzɪŋ hɪz bæŋk kɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Mark a réglé le montant total avec sa carte bancaire.

sentences.text_target: He carefully packed his heavy bags with plastic handles.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkeəfʊli pækt hɪz ˈhɛvi bæɡz wɪð ˈplæstɪk ˈhændəlz/
sentences.text_native: Il a rangé soigneusement ses sacs lourds dotés de poignées en plastique.

sentences.text_target: When he exited the shop, heavy rain started falling.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn hiː ˈɛksɪtɪd ðə ʃɒp, ˈhɛvi reɪn ˈstɑːtɪd ˈfɔːlɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Lorsqu'il est sorti du magasin, une forte pluie a commencé à tomber.

sentences.text_target: He quickly opened his large umbrella to stay dry.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkwɪkli ˈəʊpənd hɪz lɑːrdʒ ʌmˈbrɛlə tuː steɪ draɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il a rapidement ouvert son grand parapluie pour rester au sec.

sentences.text_target: Safely back home, he began to cook his delicious dinner.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈseɪfli bæk həʊm, hiː bɪˈɡæn tuː kʊk hɪz dɪˈlɪʃəs ˈdɪnə/
sentences.text_native: De retour chez lui en toute sécurité, il a commencé à cuisiner son délicieux dîner.
